critical_observations: Independently expanded, factored, and evaluated all ten distributive-structure applications; every keyed expression and unit is correct.
Checks included 6(3x+4), 5x(3x+2), (2x+3)(x+6), and the combined expression 24x+27 = 3(8x+9).
artifact_findings: Exactly ten contextual problems are present with explicit givens and appropriate units.
Representations progress from single distribution through factoring and binomial products.
The full key explains structure and common errors, and the study guide is directly aligned.
rationale: A concise, accurate representations workshop that makes distributive structure visible in meaningful Algebra 1 contexts.
